requirement: Price-snapshot store: open + close for every market
what_was_built: Built. One row per game / market / side with an opening and a closing endpoint, each naming the pinned file it came from and its evidence class.
what_it_proves_and_does_not: Every originated market HAS a snapshot row (requirement met literally). Only 2,916 rows carry BOTH endpoints, all of them the spread in 2013–2018. The total has an opener only in 2021; the moneyline has no opener anywhere in the archive.
decision_left_open: No official price feed is reachable. Buying one is PRICE-01 and is the only way to close this.

requirement: Verified results feed so a backtest and ROI can be computed
what_was_built: Built. Per-game official finals with URL, the page they were read from, the read time and the evidence class; derived settlement per market from the closing line.
evidence: results-feed.html; data/results/verified_results.csv (150 rows: 29 FINAL, 1 UNVERIFIED, 13 FUTURE, 107 COMMUNITY_ONLY)
what_it_proves_and_does_not: All 30 already-settled games and 14 freshly read Week 8 finals are in one feed. Weeks 1–7 carry only community finals and are labelled as such, so a settlement can use 30 games, not 108.
decision_left_open: nfl.com now hides scores from this client on some pages (the 'Hidden Score' text). Reading every game page or the Game Book PDF is a scheduled job: RES-01.

requirement: Originate side, then total, then moneyline
what_was_built: Built. The origination module emits markets in that fixed order, with the reason each is where it is, and the moneyline is derived from the margin distribution rather than modelled twice.
what_it_proves_and_does_not: The order is enforced in the data layout and on the page. The moneyline fair price is a transform of the side distribution, stated on every row.
decision_left_open: Whether to model the moneyline separately (it would need its own features and its own walk-forward window) is Q3.

requirement: Fair line, market line and difference as separate columns
what_was_built: Built. Nine columns: fair, market and difference for each of the three markets, with one stated sign convention and an explicit `edge_available` column.
what_it_proves_and_does_not: The difference is arithmetic and is never called an edge. On paired out-of-sample rows the model's fair number is WORSE than the market close on all three markets (side 10.523 vs 10.215 MAE; total 10.762 vs 10.527; moneyline 0.449 vs 0.424).
decision_left_open: The model as it stands does not beat the closing line. Improving it, or beating a different number (an opener, a stale line), is Q2.

requirement: Separate signal from staking on the leaderboard
what_was_built: Built. Two independent tests per strategy — signal (Spearman ρ of the model's own disagreement against realised pnl, weekly-block interval) and staking (ROI with the same interval) — with a combined verdict that needs both.
what_it_proves_and_does_not: The old number-one by ROI, WIND_UNDER (+9.15% on 456 bets), has ρ = −0.021 with an interval containing zero: it is now labelled LUCK_RISK and ranks 13th. BUY_LOW_ATS is the only strategy with signal evidence (ρ = +0.064, interval [+0.012, +0.111]) and its ROI is still negative.
decision_left_open: One signal in 18 tests is close to what multiple testing produces by chance. Nothing here is promoted; the Holm correction on the old page remains the authority.

requirement: Track the depth of the replacement, not the fact of a replacement
what_was_built: Built. Official injuries joined to official club depth charts; every hole carries a 1/rank weight, the deepest slot the club must use, and a cliff flag where no backup is listed.
what_it_proves_and_does_not: 30 club-units are fully verified, 9 partial, 3 have no chart (Houston publishes an image). 89 of 160 unavailable or at-risk players could be matched to a chart slot; 71 could not and are counted, not dropped. Example: Washington's TE #8 has no listed backup behind rank 2.
decision_left_open: A chart order is not a game-time role. Official pregame inactives (T-90m) are not archived, so no depth claim is made about who actually plays: DEP-01.

requirement: Correlations only from officially sourced numbers, with n published
what_was_built: Built. Six relationships from pairs where both the market number and the outcome come from the same pinned archive row; every row prints n, weeks, a week-block interval and a signed convention.
what_it_proves_and_does_not: n = 5,213 pairs, 425 weeks for every row. Three are distinguishable from zero (side vs moneyline ρ = +0.806; moneyline vs margin ρ = −0.441; signed model edge vs margin ρ = +0.178) and three are not (margin vs total ρ = +0.014; covers vs over ρ = −0.002; spread line vs total line ρ = −0.002).
decision_left_open: The 'officially sourced' label means the values are the league's own numbers as mirrored by the pinned archive, not that they were read from nfl.com. Two sign errors were found and fixed while building this page — see F-2026-11-14-02.

requirement: A demotion gate that sends a live strategy back to paper
what_was_built: Built. Four states and six fail-closed triggers; any one trigger demotes. The gate executes against every strategy on every build.
what_it_proves_and_does_not: No strategy is LIVE, so nothing can be demoted; the gate reports that instead of a green tick. The four strategies with a settled forward pick have one each, and D1/D2 report 'not computable' rather than a pass.
decision_left_open: The gate has never been exercised on real live evidence. A paper-trading period is what would exercise it: COMP-01.

requirement: A dedicated suggestions section, reviewed before any change
what_was_built: Built. This page: nine brief items, the new proposals this session's evidence produced, and the pre-decision questions, each cross-referenced to the existing registers.
what_it_proves_and_does_not: Nothing on this page is implemented. The new proposals are checked against the 76 existing titles and the overlaps are listed rather than duplicated. Requirements.html, from the parallel session, marks the same three items MET rather than delivered-with-a-caveat.
decision_left_open: A path has to be chosen before any of the proposals runs. That is the owner's decision.
